lines.en: Look at this picture. What do you see?
I see a big curve. It looks like a hill.
Good. And the tree has sharp angles.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 그리고 나무에는 날카로운 각도가 있어요.

lines.en: Why is the edge so dark?
The dark edge makes a nice contrast.
I drew a pattern like this yesterday.
I saw it yesterday. It had a good rhythm.
Can we draw together after lunch?
Of course. We will draw simple forms first.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 먼저 단순한 형태부터 그릴 거예요.

lines.en: Great! I will get my pencils now.
Excuse me. Can you tell me about this painting?
lines.ko: 실례해요. 이 그림에 대해 말해 줄 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure, Ma'am. Look at the composition first.
The house is on the left. Is that balance?
Yes. The tree on the right gives balance.
The surface looks rough. Why?
The artist used thick paint many years ago.
I like the curves and angles in the sky.
The curves make a soft rhythm. Do you see?
Yes, I see it now. Thank you so much.
You are welcome. I will show you the next hall.
